hooks.name: Validate Docker on Change
hooks.description: Validates Dockerfile and docker-compose changes for best practices

action.prompt: A Docker file was modified. Verify: 1) Multi-stage build is used. 2) Non-root user for runtime. 3) No secrets in image layers. 4) Specific base image tags (not latest). 5) HEALTHCHECK defined. 6) .dockerignore exists and excludes .git, node_modules, __pycache__.
